title: Chapter 51: The Choice
html:
Dark circles beneath his eyes, Chen Ge stood before the mirror with the dolls clutched to his chest. One minute until midnight.

The bathroom lights were off. He braced both hands on the sink and leaned close to the glass, staring so intently at his reflection that he hardly dared blink.

With only seconds left until midnight, the phone in his pocket vibrated.

A call? Who would call at such a time?

The call startled him. He snatched out his phone and saw Inspector Lee’s name on the screen.

Has there been some kind of accident?

Chen Ge answered and pressed the phone to his ear. “Uncle San Bao, do you have an update?”

Inspector Lee’s voice was tense and urgent. “Zhang Peng is still at large, but we believe he’s somewhere in western Jiujiang. Be careful. The man is both dangerous and cunning, and his behavior is anything but rational. We can’t rule out the possibility that he’ll come back for you.”

“But didn’t the police seal off New Century Park yesterday? Both his arms were injured. He couldn’t have gotten far.” Chen Ge had been certain Zhang Peng would be caught.

“Something unexpected happened. I can’t give you the details yet, but one of the officers who intercepted him last night suffered some kind of trauma. He’s in a deep coma at the hospital.”

“What?!” Chen Ge’s expression tightened. He was about to respond when something at the edge of his vision drew his gaze to the mirror. While he had been distracted, a bloody numeral had appeared on its surface: 1.

“But don’t worry, the police are closing in on him. Justice always prevails.”

Inspector Lee kept talking, but Chen Ge no longer heard him. He lowered the phone and stared blankly at the mirror.

When did that appear? The mirror monster already left. Why is the number still here?

He remembered the scene in the bathroom the previous day: half the mirror monster’s body protruding from the glass as Zhang Peng stepped forward of his own accord and merged with it.

What does this number really mean? Yesterday it was 2, and today it is 1. Does this mean it’ll become zero tomorrow?

The falling count filled him with dread. The number began dropping after the mirror monster possessed Zhang Peng. Now Inspector Lee says an officer has fallen into a coma, and it drops again. Is it counting victims? Does the monster need three living people?

Whatever the number meant, innocent lives were now at stake. He could no longer afford to wait.

The mirror monster is getting stronger. Tomorrow night may already be my last chance.

He scrubbed the number from the glass with a dirty cloth. Playing it safe was no longer an option. After exchanging a few final words with Inspector Lee, he ended the call and carried the black phone into the Props Room.

A new day has begun, so the Daily Missions should have refreshed. The only things that might help me now are the Red Specter’s Bloody Heart Mission and the new Nightmare Mission.

He opened the app’s Daily Mission screen.

Easy Mission: A normal Haunted House experience should not leave visitors permanently traumatized. I hope you understand this simple principle. Inspect the Haunted House for hidden safety hazards and improve its security.

Normal Mission: You have met the requirements for the Haunted House’s first expansion. Find a suitable location as soon as possible! Space limitations currently prevent you from undertaking Trial Missions to unlock new scenarios.

Nightmare Mission: Someone else has always lived in your room. Wouldn’t you like to meet them?

(Warning! The greater the difficulty, the greater the danger. Choose carefully!)

Of the three, the Nightmare Mission held his attention. Someone else in my room? The description alone makes me uneasy.

Chen Ge understood how dangerous a Nightmare Mission could be. After a long hesitation, he opened the Red Specter’s page instead.

“Are you sure you want to accept Zhang Ya’s Bloody Heart Mission? Warning! This mission contains a certain level of danger!”

The app supplied its warning. Chen Ge rubbed his temples, still unable to decide.

Both missions are dangerous, but a Nightmare Mission gives a random reward. I might end up with nothing more than another support skill. The Bloody Heart Mission is different. Zhang Ya has the special title of Red Specter and even has her own page in the app. She must be several levels stronger than the mirror monster. With her help, I might survive this.

Having weighed the risks, Chen Ge gritted his teeth and selected Zhang Ya’s Bloody Heart Mission.

“Are you sure you want to accept Zhang Ya’s Bloody Heart Mission?”

“Yes!”

The red interface shifted, peeling apart like the petals of a wilting rose. A new message appeared.

“Andersen’s Fairy Tales, Volume One, Book Three—The Red Shoes: Once upon a time, there was a pair of ruby-red dancing shoes. Whoever wore them became light on her feet and danced with perfect grace. Yet no dancer dared put them on, for the enchanted shoes would force their wearer to dance until she died of exhaustion.

“Reach Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy within one hour of accepting this mission and find Zhang Ya’s red dancing shoes before dawn.

“Warning: Don’t be late on your first date, or she’ll be very unhappy.”

Chen Ge was not sure how to react. The academy had been abandoned years ago for reasons no one seemed to know, and he had heard more than enough disturbing rumors about it.

My first date with a girl is after midnight at an abandoned school. Am I really that unlucky in love?

He had to reach the academy within an hour. After estimating the distance, he realized he still had time to spare.

It’s on this side of town, so it isn’t far. Going there after midnight is the real problem. Still, I should shower first. Whatever else happens, this is my first date.

After a quick shower, Chen Ge changed into clean clothes and inspected himself in the mirror.

I still have fifty minutes. Why am I suddenly so nervous?
